clarifications.fingerCoverage: The primary profile uses one continuously moving pointer plus concurrent touch auto-fire/focus controls. It does not exercise an actual second pointer or the Launcher two-finger owner. Real multi-pointer gesture/lifecycle acceptance remains pending.
clarifications.inputRoute: The new workload submits via public native touch ABI. It does not use DOM PointerEvent dispatch, Launcher __eaglerDirectInputBridge or TH09 managed postMessage queue.
clarifications.responseClaim: Report conditional changed-wire-to-render-progress association and all due/future-censored source events. A changed field after the latest event is not proof of that event causing a pixel change; game readiness, focus speed, collision/death and clipping are retained context.
clarifications.cpuScope: The manual three-world gate uses one shared renderer at CPU4, including the exact reference. The independent-browser performance runs use rates [1,4].
clarifications.bodyPolicy: Keep continuous prediction-frontier windows and endpoint observations. Publish sampledAt intervals separately from RAF timestamps and keep startup/tail/longest gap.
clarifications.baselineScope: Old E diagnostic and release builds remain the controls. Wall-clock actual input tape may differ across runs even with identical source plans; within-run confirmed agreement is mandatory.
